name: Penne Pasta with Smooth Italian Marinara Sauce
whyItWorks: Boiled tender penne pasta topped with smooth, strained sweet tomato marinara sauce without seeds or skins provides clean, gut-friendly complex carbohydrates and easy energy for a long day in the park.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request plain penne pasta with smooth marinara sauce. Skip meatballs or heavy parmesan if watching saturated fat and dairy.
